headline: Southborough boards advanced the FY27 budget and an 8.8 million dollar Trottier roof bond while deferring major road borrowing decisions before Town Meeting.
synopsis: Town boards focused heavily on the April 11 Annual Town Meeting warrant, with the Select Board and Advisory Committee both recommending the FY27 operating budget. Officials endorsed an 8.8 million dollar roof replacement for Trottier Middle School, which will require both Town Meeting approval and a Proposition 2 1/2 debt exclusion ballot vote. Committees removed an 820,000 dollar Atwood water tank site cleanup from the spring warrant, and both the Select Board and Capital Improvement and Planning Committee held recommendations on a 22 million dollar road and sidewalk bond pending further debt analysis. Additionally, the Select Board approved the appointment structure for the new Elementary School Building Committee and reviewed an actuarial report showing the town's net retiree healthcare liability grew to 54.4 million dollars.

highlights.title: Trottier Middle School roof replacement endorsed
highlights.why: The Select Board and Capital Committee supported the 8.83 million dollar roof project, which carries an estimated net town cost of 5.39 million dollars after MSBA reimbursement and requires a ballot debt exclusion.

highlights.title: FY27 operating budget recommended
highlights.why: The Advisory Committee voted 5-0 to recommend a 73.46 million dollar FY27 budget, a 4.64 percent spending increase, after removing 820,000 dollars for Atwood water tank remediation.

highlights.title: Road and sidewalk bonding deferred for debt review
highlights.why: Committees deferred recommendations on borrowing up to 22 million to 25 million dollars for townwide paving and sidewalks until cash flow and median tax impact projections are presented in April.

highlights.title: Retiree healthcare liability increases to 54.4 million dollars
highlights.why: An actuarial valuation revealed a sharp jump in the town's net OPEB liability from 38.7 million dollars, driven by an 88 percent spike in Medicare Advantage plan premiums.

highlights.title: Elementary School Building Committee structure established
highlights.why: The Select Board approved a five-member committee composition with three Select Board appointees and two School Committee appointees to review future options for the Neary School.

highlights.title: Route 9 wastewater financing district modeled
highlights.why: The committee reviewed an interactive mapping model for a District Improvement Financing area covering 580 parcels along Route 9 to help fund future wastewater infrastructure.
